prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return solution.go in package solution.
Required API: func SignedDistance(input string) (string, bool)
Behavior: Parse canonical a;b, where each field is one signed decimal integer in -1000..1000. Return the absolute distance between a and b as a decimal string. Reject malformed or out-of-range input.
Visible example: -4;7 returns 11.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
